intro: Croatia is a parliamentary republic and a member of the EU, NATO, the eurozone and the Schengen area.

chapters.title: Sabor and president
text: The parliament, the Sabor, chooses the prime minister. The president is directly elected for five years. Croatia is divided into 20 counties plus the city of Zagreb.

chapters.title: Symbols
text: The flag shows red, white and blue stripes with a red-and-white checkerboard shield, also worn on Croatia's football shirts. Statehood Day is 30 May.

keyTerms.meaning: European countries that have removed passport checks at their shared borders.
